queries.query: Nzérékoré Guinea official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery found Guinea's official land-title procedure, a DGPEIP cadastral-coverage page, a municipal territorial map, and a Guinea mining-cadastre ArcGIS service. No open first-party general land-parcel viewer or anonymous parcel API for Nzérékoré was verified.

queries.query: Nzérékoré Guinée carte cadastrale parcelles registre foncier service officiel
queries.result: La recherche officielle a trouvé la procédure nationale de titre foncier, les statistiques de couverture cadastrale de la DGPEIP, la carte territoriale municipale et un service ArcGIS de cadastre minier. Aucun service public de parcelles foncières générales ni API anonyme de géométrie pour N'Zérékoré n'a été vérifié.

registryCustodian: The official Service Public Guinea procedure identifies the mayor of the concerned commune and the Directeur Général de la Conservation Foncière for title registration; DGPEIP publishes national cadastral-coverage statistics. No local Nzérékoré parcel registry or public geometry endpoint was verified.

registryEvidence.interpretation: National procedure and agency evidence establish custodial context only. registryFound remains null because no actual public local registry, parcel map, parcel lookup, or general-land geometry service was verified.

sourceReview.service: No verified public general-land parcel service; official ArcGIS lead is a mining-cadastre country layer and is out of scope for ordinary cadastral parcels.
sourceReview.crs: Mining-cadastre country layer metadata reports WKID 104257/latestWkid 8999; no parcel CRS was obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
